title: Attractive, programmable, works as slow cooker and steamer as well as a rice cooker
text: Attractive, programmable, works as slow cooker and steamer as well as a rice cooker. After cooking rice in the microwave for over 35 years, I thought it would be nice to have a real rice cooker.  You can make really nice rice in a microwave, but there are some good advantages to this rice cooker.  The first advantage is being able to program it in advance when you want it to start cooking.  If you are not home when you need to start the rice cooking, you set it up to start at a particular time.  Another advantage to this cooker is that it eliminates the need for a crock pot (slow cooker) as it works for that as well.  There is also a steamer basket in it, so you can steam vegetables and the instructions even say you can do it as the same time as you are making rice.  Instruction booklet is well illustrated and seems very comprehensive and complete (something that is a rarity these days).  The cooker is attractive with a digital control panel. The only issue that I found was that some of the buttons on the digital controls are a little small and close together, so you might easily hit the wrong button if you fat finger it.  Otherwise this is a nice cooker and has settings for different kinds of rice.  Made in China, but appears to be a U.S. Company.  Has a 5-year warranty, which is longer than most small kitchen appliances.  Claims to be BPA free.  A must for families that eat a lot of rice.

product_metadata.title: Aroma Housewares ARC-980SB Professional 20-cup (Cooked) Digital Rice Cooker,Multi Cooker
features: Perfectly prepares 4 to 20 cups of any variety of cooked rice
Easy-to-use, programmable digital controls with automatic Keep-Warm and White Rice, Brown Rice, Quick Rice,STS, Steam, Soup, Cake and Slow Cook functions
Sauté-Then-Simmer(STS) function provides high heat sautéing that automatically switches to simmer once liquid is added
15- hour Delay Timer for flexible meal planning
description: Enjoy easy home cooking with the Aroma 20-Cup (Cooked) Rice Cooker, Food Steamer and Slow Cooker. Restaurant-quality rice. Healthy steamed meals. Delicious one-pot dishes. Prepare all this and more at the touch of a button! Aroma takes the "cook" out of home cooking - turning kitchen time into your time! Help the kids with homework, get creative at play time or pick up that novel you've been waiting to dive into. All while delivering hot, hearty and healthy meals the entire family will love.This convenient cooker's generous capacity perfectly cooks 4 to 20 cups of any variety of rice with specialized functions for both White and Brown Rice. Once the rice has finished, it will automatically switch to Keep-Warm so there's no need for monitoring or stirring. The Steam Tray allows for healthy steaming of meats and vegetables, even as rice cooks below! Aroma's Slow Cook function transforms your rice cooker into a 4-quart slow cooker, furthering its use as a meal-making powerhouse. With Aroma's patent-pending Sauté-Then-Simmé function you can further automate your kitchen. Reaching a high heat to sauté or brown foods then switching over to a simmer once liquid is added, this time-saving function is the perfect choice for Spanish rice, chili, risotto, packaged meals and much more! The programmable 15-hour delay timer is great for families on the go, delivering delicious rice ready when it's needed. And when the cooking is done, the inner cooking pot and all accessories remove for easy cleanup in the dishwasher.Steam Tray, Rice Measuring Cup and Serving Spatula included.
